target: One scalar or finite-rank normally-hyperbolic factor on a globally hyperbolic spacetime, with existence, uniqueness, continuity, advanced/retarded maps, and causal support kept separate.
answer: Classical existence and strict causal support are directly established in the reviewed smooth and metric-graph literature. Computable solution operators are directly established for represented symmetric-hyperbolic systems, but the reviewed computability papers do not construct globally hyperbolic advanced/retarded Green maps. No direct second-order-arithmetic reversal or Bishop-style global Green theorem was located in the bounded search. Choice-sensitive Hilbert-space results show that the ambient operator theory cannot be treated as automatically choice-free. Exact finite graph-step Green kernels are separately certified locally.

bounded_search.negative_finding_rule: NO_DIRECT_THEOREM means none was identified among the screened results; it never means that no such literature exists.

cell_actions.basis: Self-adjoint Hilbert-space Laplacians on metric graphs have well-posed wave evolution and strict finite propagation.
The metric-graph theorem proves existence and uniqueness for the specified finite/network geometry.
The same theorem proves strict finite propagation under its local boundary conditions.
Effective evolution and reverse functional-analysis ingredients exist, but no coded generator theorem or subsystem calibration was located.
Computable solution operators are adjacent, but no second-order-arithmetic upper bound or reversal was located.
Classical support and effective evolution exist separately; their combination has not been formalized over a weak subsystem.
A represented symmetric-hyperbolic solution operator is computable, but an explicit computable generator/domain/spectral theorem is still missing.
ZF Hilbert theory and classical causal PDE are known separately; the Sobolev/Green construction has not been proved choice-free.
Exact rational retarded/advanced kernels have a certified graph-step support cone on the displayed finite fixtures.

evidence_overlays.basis: The symmetric-hyperbolic Cauchy theorem gives existence, uniqueness and continuous dependence.
The normally- and prenormally-hyperbolic theorems give advanced/retarded Green maps with causal support.
The represented symmetric-hyperbolic solution operator is computable with effective approximation and complexity bounds in the papers' scope.
Computable evolution is direct evidence for one ingredient, while strict globally-hyperbolic Green support remains outside the theorem.
Lieb-Robinson decay supplies an effective lattice cone, explicitly distinguished from strict support.

does_not_establish: an RCA_0, WKL_0 or ACA_0 equivalence
a Bishop-constructive globally hyperbolic Green theorem
a continuum limit from finite graphs
a full off-shell Weyl metric BV propagator
renormalized Lorentzian products or a Lorentzian QME
